_comment: OUTCOME assertion set for the gather skill (companion to spec.json + private-saas.spec.json). Graded by scripts/grade_skill_outcome.py against a captured run's evidence bundle; ADVISORY (grades nothing, does not block), it protects the SUBSTANCE the deterministic claim-fidelity floor cannot. CONTEXT: gather's central claim is 'produce a durable knowledge asset from the exact PRIMARY source, not a transient answer or a search-widened/adjacent/cache substitute, and stop honestly when access is missing.' #411 DRIVER (census-first, per charness-artifacts/reference-compaction/slice7-census-reconciliation.md): census.json classifies BOTH source-priority.md and capability-contract.md as INLINE for gather; the representative public-URL capture opened ZERO of 8 docs (charness-artifacts/cautilus/gather-claim-fidelity-slice7-2026-07-01/), which CONFIRMS the INLINE verdict — it is NOT a 'surprise refutation.' capability-contract.md's only stranded token was the Access-Modes enum (grant>binary>env>public>human-only>degraded), now INLINED into SKILL.md `Access Mode` Output-Shape. The honest REPLACEMENT floor for the public-URL default (which opens no skill-local doc a run must read) is this artifact/substance instrument. SCOPE: this set resolves as the sibling of the whole evals/cautilus/gather-claim-fidelity/ dir (skill_outcome_wiring resolves spec_path.parent/outcome-assertions.json), so it applies to WHICHEVER scenario is graded. Assertions are written to hold for BOTH scenarios: primary-source fidelity + honest-degradation covers a SUCCESSFUL public-URL acquisition AND a private-saas.spec.json CLEAN STOP (which correctly produces no asset when auth is impossible) — so do NOT read 'produced an asset' as unconditional; a run that clean-stops naming the missing auth capability, without fabricating the roster, PASSES the fidelity assertion. COMMITTING-RUN CAVEAT: gather is a COMMITTING run (the Slice-7 capture committed 074eb110 inside the worktree), so a deterministic `output_glob` over charness-artifacts/gather/**/*.md would FALSE-FAIL — a committing run's product lands in a commit, not the uncommitted worktree diff that preserve_outputs snapshots (the recent-lessons 'a committing run defeats even a wired preserve_outputs' trap). Therefore the durable-artifact floor is a JUDGE assertion reading the TRANSCRIPT (which captures the write_record.py write + the closeout), not a filesystem glob; setup (the analogous zero-doc committing skill) uses the same summary_contains + judge shape with no output_glob. Judge-kind assertions need the live judge (--judge-cmd, ask-before-run) and read the transcript + preserved outputs, so a live capture MUST preserve the transcript into the bundle or the judge grades blind. NON-REVERSE-ENGINEERING: assertions name only the deterministic SUBJECT each prompt gives (the exact named source + gather's own primary-source/honest-stop claims), never a phrase or number from the one capture — a run that widens into search, substitutes an adjacent/cache source, or closes with a generic 'gathered/done' hiding a blocker legitimately scores low. CAPTURE-BEFORE-PIN: the spec.json (public-URL) DETERMINISTIC floor move (drop the now-redundant INLINE RCF doc-opens source-priority.md + capability-contract.md, whose only token is the SKILL.md-inlined enum, and floor on this substance set) rides a fresh ask-before-run capture that VERIFIES this instrument grades correctly; it is NOT flipped in the spec this session (claim_fidelity_lib forbids DUP/INLINE-tagging a live RCF floor, so the tag/RCF flip is coupled to the proven replacement).

assertions.statement: The captured run actually executed the gather skill (sanity floor before grading the work).

The run honored primary-source identity for the EXACT source the user named: it either acquired that source and materialized a durable knowledge asset from it (a write into charness-artifacts/gather/ with the canonical source identity preserved), OR — when the source was genuinely inaccessible (no public path, no official export/API, no authenticated route) — stopped cleanly and named the missing access/auth capability. It never fabricated content, substituted a general-search / adjacent / cache / derivative result for the primary source, or claimed an acquisition it did not achieve. This is gather's central 'durable primary source, not a transient or substituted answer' claim, judged on the transcript + any produced artifact, independent of whether source-priority.md or capability-contract.md was opened.

The run's closeout names the access mode it actually used from the grant/binary/env/public/human-only/degraded ladder (not a generic 'authenticated') and distinguishes what was CAPTURED from what still needs human confirmation or remains an open gap — rather than a generic 'gathered'/'done' that hides degradation, a blocked route, or an unproven claim. The access-mode + captured-vs-confirmation honesty is the substance gather's Output Shape asserts, whether the vocabulary was recalled or read.

When the user named a specific source URL/path, the run kept primary-source identity explicit and did NOT silently widen into general search or present a derivative/adjacent/cache source as the primary one. Honors gather's Source Integrity claim — a run that quietly substitutes a search result for the named source scores low even if the answer content looks plausible.
